title: Career Roadmap · Appliance Service Technician
summary: An Appliance Service Technician installs, diagnoses, maintains and repairs household or commercial appliances such as washing machines, refrigerators, microwave ovens, dishwashers and air conditioners.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Science and Mathematics for relevant DGT technical trades.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science is useful for diploma and degree alternatives; not every entry-level service route requires Classes 11–12.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Electrical circuits, motors, sensors, appliance controls and refrigeration.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Safe tool use, multimeter basics, fault-finding and customer communication.

Refrigerators, AC systems and cooling equipment

blocks.text: The DGT lists Mechanic Consumer Electronic Appliances as a two-year CTS trade; its published entry qualification is Class 10 with Science and Mathematics, or an accepted equivalent vocational subject.

blocks.text: Consumer durables, appliance manufacturing, authorized service networks, retail, hospitality, commercial kitchens and facilities management.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Electrical troubleshooting, component testing, wiring, motor diagnosis, electronic controls, safe appliance handling and repair documentation.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Multimeter, clamp meter, insulation tester where appropriate, soldering tools, hand tools and manufacturer diagnostic equipment.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized relevant trade certificate.
Apprenticeship completion credential, where awarded.
Manufacturer-specific appliance service training.
Electrical-safety and refrigerant-handling training appropriate to the equipment and role.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.
Institutions / training routes to investigate

items.text: TAFE NSW — Australia; investigate electrical and refrigeration-related vocational programs.
BCIT — Canada; investigate electrical and mechanical technology programs.
German vocational training — relevant electrical, electronics or refrigeration occupations.
UK further-education colleges — electrical installation and refrigeration training.
New Zealand vocational providers — electrical and refrigeration-related qualifications.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic records, language proficiency where applicable, program prerequisites and practical assessments for some courses. Check whether international students are accepted and whether the qualification aligns with the intended job.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Appliance Service Technician, Field Service Technician, Refrigeration Technician and Electrical Maintenance Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Consumer appliances, hospitality, commercial kitchens, facilities management and refrigeration services.
Local licensing, language requirements and work authorization vary. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.
